description: Audit one URL immediately and return its SEO issues (schema bseoa.issue/v1: key, category, severity, message, fix_hint, docs_url). This is the fast path and the right first call for "what is wrong with this page?" - it fetches a single page and never follows links. Prefer it over start_crawl whenever the user asked about one specific page rather than a whole site, and that includes a site's homepage or bare domain ("check https://example.com/ for SEO problems") when the user did not ask for a crawl, a site audit or a number of pages. Does not count against the account's page budget; limited to 30 calls a minute. JavaScript rendering (spa) is not available on the hosted connector.

spa.description:
Render JavaScript with a headless browser before auditing. Slower; only
needed for single-page apps whose content is not in the served HTML.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to audit, including the scheme (https://...).

name: check_page
